Ablative Barrier.descriptionOnly: the first 5 points of lethal damage of each attack made nonlethal, DR 5/— against nonlethal attacks alone, and its discharge after 5 points per caster level (50 at most), at the table

Absorb Toxicity.descriptionOnly: once it absorbs one, it is immune to that one alone; the +2 on saves against the absorbed affliction when the spell expires, and the touched target's save, are told here

Adoration.descriptionOnly: out of combat; in performance combat its +2 morale is on performance combat checks instead, at the table

Air Bubble.descriptionOnly: no path: the –2 on attack rolls for every 5 feet of water is the rules' for firing underwater

Animal Aspect.descriptionOnly: the otter's swim speed and the tree lizard's climb speed, half its speed, the gorilla's unarmed damage a step larger, and the otter's breath held 4 rounds per point of Constitution, at the table

Arcane Cannon.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Brow Gasher.descriptionOnly: no path: the struck creature's bleed (half caster level) and its cumulative –1 on attack rolls each turn, concealment at –3 and blindness at –5, at the table

Bullet Shield.descriptionOnly: against firearms and ranged attacks; +4, +1 more for every five caster levels, +8 at most

Burst of Speed.descriptionOnly: until the end of its turn; +10 feet instead in medium or heavy armor, at the table

Certain Grip.descriptionOnly: its immunity to disarm is told here

choices.label: Deadly Juggernaut: qualifying opponents reduced to 0 hit points

Deadly Juggernaut.descriptionOnly: +1 luck and DR 2/— for each qualifying opponent, +5 and DR 10/— at most; a qualifying opponent has Hit Dice at least its own –4

Destabilize Powder.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Discovery Torch.descriptionOnly: allies in its light; the +2 on Knowledge checks to identify the monsters in its light is told here

Effortless Armor.descriptionOnly: its armor check penalty lessened by 1, 1 more for every five caster levels, 5 at most; its armor no longer reduces its speed, at the table

Flash Fire.descriptionOnly: no path: the carrier's –4 on its save against the flash, and the blindness of 1d4 rounds, at the table

Frightful Aspect.descriptionOnly: its aura of fear is told here

Haunted Fey Aspect.descriptionOnly: no path: its DR 1/cold iron against a single opponent alone, at the table

Healing Thief.descriptionOnly: no path: the healing it steals, 5 hit points per caster level (50 hit points at most), at the table

Heroic Invocation.descriptionOnly: its temporary hit points, 2d8+4, are told here; the subjects are fatigued when it ends

Hostile Levitation.descriptionOnly: the –1 on its first weapon attack, –2 on the second and so on, –5 at most, at the table

Instrument of Agony.descriptionOnly: while wielding the weapon; the struck creature's nausea of 1d4+1 rounds is told here

choices.label: Judgment Light: the energy of resistance

Judgment Light.descriptionOnly: justice's –20 is on the revealed creatures; destruction's 4d8 damage, healing's 1d8 + Wisdom modifier, piercing's spell resistance reduced by 5, purity's +2 sacred on one save, resiliency's DR 3 of the judgment's alignment, and smiting's weapons, at the table

Liberating Command.descriptionOnly: no path: its competence bonus on one Escape Artist check, twice caster level (+20 at most), at the table

Litany of Defense.descriptionOnly: its armor's enhancement bonus doubled is told here

Litany of Vengeance.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Litany of Warding.descriptionOnly: its two more attacks of opportunity this round are told here

Magic Siege Engine.descriptionOnly: no path: the siege engine's +1 enhancement on targeting and damage rolls is its own

Mirror Strike.descriptionOnly: no path: the +2 on its one split attack roll when flanked, at the table

Negative Reaction.descriptionOnly: the –10 on performance combat checks too, at the table

Phantom Chariot.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Phantom Driver.descriptionOnly: no path: the driver's AC 20 (+1 size, +4 natural armor, +5 Dex) or 19, and 7 hit points + 1 per caster level, are its own

Pilfering Hand.descriptionOnly: no path: its combat maneuver bonus is caster level plus a casting ability modifier, and the target's +2 on Perception to notice it, at the table

Pup Shape.descriptionOnly: its scores 1 at least; Small, or one size smaller than its own when that is smaller; its 1 HD at maximum hit points and the attackers' Will save, at the table

Resinous Skin.descriptionOnly: the +2 is to initiate, maintain and pin in a grapple; the grappled enemy's –2 to break free and the stuck weapons are told here

Shock Shield.descriptionOnly: its burst's 1d6 electricity damage is told here

Stabilize Powder.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Symbol of Striking.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Tactical Acumen.descriptionOnly: +1, +1 more for every five caster levels above 5th, +4 at most; with flanking, higher ground or cover

Tar Pool.descriptionOnly: no path: its fire damage, the Acrobatics DC +5 in the area, the –4 of a prone creature on its save and its checks to escape, and the –4 of a creature with tar on it on Acrobatics and Fly checks to fly with wings, at the table

Telekinetic Charge.descriptionOnly: no path: the +2 on its one melee attack on landing, at the table

Thunder Fire.descriptionOnly: no path: the wielder's –4 on its save against the deafening, and its misfire range +1 for 1d4 rounds, at the table

Unerring Weapon.descriptionOnly: +2, +1 more for every four caster levels, +7 at most

Weaken Powder.descriptionOnly: with the altered ammunition alone; its range increment halved is told here

Wilderness Soldiers.descriptionOnly: no path: the plants' attacks, their +1 damage per three caster levels (+5 at most), and the undergrowth's +2 CMD are their own

Wreath of Blades.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table
